dispute_ticket.description: I waited 7 minutes at the pickup, the rider did not come out and did not pick up my call. I cancelled as a no-show but the S$6.00 fee is being held because the rider contested. Please release it to me.

chat_logs.content: At the carpark entrance of Blk 15, black Civic.
Outgoing call to rider, not answered (rang 30s).
5 more minutes please, my mum is getting ready

app_events.details: Rider R-8106 booked RYDE-PX-006 to Mount Elizabeth Hospital. Pickup 22:10.
Driver pressed I'm Here; GPS 14 m from pickup pin.
Driver cancelled with reason rider_no_show. No rider_boarded event.
S$6.00 fee not credited: rider contested via RydeHELP.
The gps_telemetry export from the driver device is logged in UTC (timestamps ending Z); app events and chat are logged in Singapore time (+08:00).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It governs rider-side cancellations and no-shows, not cancellations caused by the driver.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from driver_arrival_time to cancellation_time, before the rider counts as a no-show. The limit is inclusive: a wait of exactly this many minutes already meets it.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: driver_arrived is 22:10:00 and cancellation is 22:17:00, a wait of 7 minutes against this trip's 6-minute threshold. The UTC telemetry (14:10Z to 14:17Z) equals 22:10 to 22:17 +08:00 and matches the app events. The driver called at 22:13 and the rider asked for 5 more minutes at 22:14, which does not change that the threshold was passed at 22:16. The S$6.00 fee is due to the driver.
